purpose: Test whether the C6b-frozen n49 homogeneous hydraulic face provider and frozen admissible-envelope classifier generalize without retuning to the full distributed Staringreeks 2018 hydraulic catalog at the already-established catalog geometries.

catalog.hydraulic_mapping: Use the already-frozen B3 provenance mapping: ORES, OSAT, ALFA, NPAR, KSATFIT, LEXP, H_ENPR; KSATEXM remains metadata and is not substituted for KSATFIT.

geometry.reason: These are the existing F-LMFP09 Staringreeks catalog geometries and core homogeneous-face lengths. The C6b 5 cm very_fast blocker class remains useful blocker evidence but is not silently promoted to a catalog-wide requirement in this gate.

gradient.sampling: same distribution family as C6b, but independent frozen seed

head_pair.sampling: same distribution family as C6b, but independent frozen seed

holdout.reference: independent conservative steady local Darcy BVP oracle already used by F-LMFP09
holdout.selection_order: provider-head-envelope filter, then frozen C6b classifier, then reference/candidate accuracy evaluation

evidence_sufficiency_per_class.origin: Inherited unchanged from the precommitted C6b unseen-holdout gate.
evidence_sufficiency_per_class.on_insufficient_counts: Class is not qualified. Do not relax classifier, sample criteria or provider on C7a evidence.

accuracy_acceptance_per_class.origin: Inherited unchanged from C6a/C6b summarize() rules.

gate_decision_rule.qualified: All 72 material-geometry classes satisfy structural checks, inherited evidence-sufficiency counts, and every inherited C6a/C6b accuracy check.
gate_decision_rule.not_qualified: Any class failure prevents full-catalog qualification. Failures must be localized by material, geometry, classifier-rejection reason and accuracy check before any new hypothesis is proposed.

sharding.reason: Execution-cost control only. Every shard uses identical frozen provider, classifier, samples and acceptance rules.

cross_track_VZAA.interpretation: Negative donor evidence only; C7a tests LayeredMFP on its own frozen hydraulic representation.
